theorem: For the apartment code of any finite generalized quadrangle, the weight-3 dual words are exactly local theta triples.
proof: A dual weight-3 word is three distinct apartments A,B,C with boundary(A)+boundary(B)+boundary(C)=0 over F2.
Hence C=A symmetric-difference B. Since A,B,C are 8-cycles, A and B share exactly four edges.
In a girth-8 generalized-quadrangle incidence graph, such a four-edge overlap must be one contiguous length-four root; otherwise the symmetric difference splits or creates a shorter circuit.
The complementary roots form C, hence A,B,C are exactly a theta triple. The converse is immediate.
